theme_and_archetype.vibe: Apple + Vogue + Apple News. Clean, modern, fast, and elegant.
theme_and_archetype.rationale: The platform needs to feel like a premium digital news/analysis magazine. High-contrast structure (black/white/grays) provides the 'Apple' cleanliness, while the serif typography and asymmetric layout provide the 'Vogue' editorial authority.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-semibold tracking-tight leading-tight font-serif
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl md:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight leading-snug font-serif
hierarchy.label: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.15em] font-sans text-[#86868B]

layout_and_spacing.general: Generous spacing. Use p-8 to p-12 for section paddings. Large typographic hierarchy and plenty of whitespace.

grids.editorial_cover: Bento Grid Mode A: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Hero article spans col-span-8. Side articles span col-span-4.
grids.viral_topics: Horizontal scroll or 4-column grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4) with gap-6.
grids.latest_articles: Grid of 3 columns (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) gap-8.

header.style: Sticky at top, glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80). Clean, 1px bottom border (border-black/5).
header.layout: Flex justify-between items-center h-20. Left: Nav links (Explorar, Tendencias, Categorías). Center: Large NOXEAL text logo (Playfair). Right: Buscar, Entrar, Suscribirse.

buttons.primary: Rounded-full px-6 py-3 bg-black text-white hover:bg-[#333333] font-sans font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: Rounded-full px-6 py-3 bg-transparent text-black border border-black/10 hover:bg-black/5 font-sans font-medium transition-colors
buttons.tertiary: Text link with underline on hover, tracking-wide text-sm font-bold uppercase

cards.editorial_large: No visible card background. Large image (aspect-[16/9] or [4/3] rounded-2xl), followed by category label, massive serif title, excerpt, and text button.
cards.editorial_small: Image aspect-[4/3] rounded-xl. Smaller serif title. Side-by-side on desktop if space permits, or stacked.
cards.viral_dark_card: Rounded-2xl p-8 bg-[#1D1D1F] border border-[#333336] text-white hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform. Internal layout: flex flex-col justify-between h-full.

inputs.search: Rounded-full bg-[#F5F5F7] border-transparent px-6 py-4 w-full text-lg focus:bg-white focus:border-black/20 focus:ring-0 outline-none transition-all
inputs.newsletter: Flex. Input is rounded-l-full bg-[#F5F5F7] border-none px-6 py-4. Button is rounded-r-full bg-black text-white px-8.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Images should slightly scale up (scale-105) inside a hidden-overflow container on hover. Links change color/opacity.
motion_and_interaction.transitions: Use smooth transitions: transition-all duration-300 ease-out.
motion_and_interaction.scroll: Implement standard smooth scrolling. Fade-in upward staggering for article cards as they enter the viewport.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the entire application uses Spanish (es) for all text and placeholder content.
Implement the Header exactly as described: Explorar, Tendencias, Categorías on the left, NOXEAL in center, Buscar, Entrar, Suscribirse on the right.
CRITICAL: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, form submissions) MUST include 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='explore-nav-link').
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Playfair Display' (serif) for all headings to achieve the Vogue aesthetic, and 'Manrope' for body copy to achieve the Apple aesthetic.
The Hero section should feature the large title: 'Entiende lo que todos comparten, antes de creerlo.' with the subtext below it.
The 'Viral Topics' (Temas virales) section MUST use dark cards (bg-[#1D1D1F]) to contrast against the mostly white/light-gray site.
Ensure border-radiuses are large (rounded-2xl) to mimic modern Apple interfaces, and whitespace is extremely generous (p-8 to p-12).
For the articles, do not use boxed card designs with heavy shadows; rely on optical alignment, large crisp images, and strong typography (borderless design for main editorial flow).
